actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: unresolved receipt leaves the process cycle stuck
actions_or_findings.trigger: Staff submits an unresolved receipt, then a supervisor chooses CONTINUE or REASSIGN.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The receipt occupies the current process cycle. CONTINUE does not open a new cycle, so a later resolved receipt returns 409. Reassignment during PROCESSING also leaves the old process open; the new assignee's receipt can retain the former assignee's process attribution. The page run used escalation without an unresolved receipt and did not exercise these paths.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: feedback can bypass a formal supervisor decision
actions_or_findings.trigger: A processing actor with work_order:decide permission sends staff feedback with process_reason=NONE on a waiting or escalated order.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The permission check allows ordinary feedback to clear the exception. A resolved receipt can then follow without a CONTINUE plan, DECIDE log, or WORK_ORDER_DECIDED audit. The unit test covers only an actor without that permission.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: API accepts an unreasoned REASSIGN
actions_or_findings.trigger: A supervisor calls the decide API with decision=REASSIGN and an empty or absent reason.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Only CONTINUE requires a reason in the service. With a selected employee, the service substitutes the literal REASSIGN; without one, it can end the assignment without a stated reason. The mini-program's required field does not protect the API.

actions_or_findings.title: NON_BLOCKING: transaction repair has controlled runtime evidence
actions_or_findings.trigger: Order 7's first redispatch failed with TransactionContractError; the failed task was replayed after the fix.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The repaired code opens its owned transaction before reading the stored analysis. The isolated worker replay returned NO_ELIGIBLE while the alternate was at capacity. After a tenant-admin API capacity change, one isolated queue retry selected employee 4, excluded rejecter 5 as RECENTLY_REJECTED, and created a system AUTO assignment without another provider call. This verifies the repair and selection path. A fresh rejection that succeeds on its first post-fix queue attempt remains unshown.

actions_or_findings.title: NON_BLOCKING: saved audit projection omits the later assignment audit
actions_or_findings.trigger: The final-business-evidence.json audits array is used to inspect reassignment.
actions_or_findings.rationale: That query filters to the creation request ID, so it shows only the first assignment audit. Code writes WORK_ORDER_REASSIGNED in the assignment transaction, and the second assignment and notification delivery are evidenced, but the saved projection does not directly show the later audit row or notification recipient.
